summary: Plan your path, snatch shiny gems, and escape collapsing temple ruins.
description:
Grabby Crab is a puzzle game about planning your path, snatching shiny gems, and escaping ancient ruins before the floor falls apart beneath your claws.

Guide a determined little crab through tricky temple chambers where every step matters. Grab the gemstone, find the portal, and try not to destroy the paths you need to escape.

This is a calm but clever path-planning puzzle game made for players who enjoy logic puzzles, grid-based challenges, and handcrafted levels without timers or pressure.

Why all this careful planning?
Because this crab really, really likes shiny things.

What to expect?

◦ Path-planning puzzle gameplay
◦ Designed for mobile: swipe controls
◦ Snatch gemstones and escape through portals
◦ Tiles that break, crack, vanish, or change the way you plan
◦ Ancient guardians that mark, block, or destroy parts of the board
◦ Gem curses that twist the rules of each level
◦ Relics that help you restore paths or reshape your escape
◦ Carefully handcrafted levels of rising difficulty
◦ No timers, no rush. Thoughtful puzzle solving
◦ Hints available if you get stuck
◦ Game Center and achievements
◦ Premium: no ads, no tracking, no distractions
◦ Play offline anytime

Grabby Crab is designed as a premium mobile puzzle game: no ads, no tracking, no distractions, and no pressure. Just plan your route, snatch the gem, and escape the ruins one clever step at a time.

I’m a solo game developer and made Grabby Crab with lots of care and passion. I hope it brings you a fun challenge, a few satisfying “aha!” moments, and a little smile along the way.
